findings.read_only_interpretation: ToolGatewayV2 uses capability.allowed_modes to block write tools, but native_runtime.py does NOT check mode before calling tools
findings.build_write_tools_blocked: Blocked only by ToolGatewayV2 for high-risk tools; no global READ mode enforcement
findings.trace_records_mode: Trace stores mode at run creation but does not log mode escalation events
findings.mode_escalation: Not implemented; if user asks for build in read mode, planner may schedule write tools and they may be blocked by ToolGatewayV2 without explanation

gaps.A: No mode escalation mechanism. Read requests that require build silently fail or produce confusing tool blocks.
gaps.B: UI has no mode selector. Both 8091/ui and 8092 hardcode mode='read_only'.
gaps.C: No distinction between dry_run and read_only semantics for UX clarity.
gaps.D: Auto mode not implemented. No automatic inference of build requirement from goal text.
gaps.E: Trace does not capture mode_requested, mode_effective, mode_escalation_required.
